objective: Give a witness-dependent rational perturbation radius and finite-grid extraction from a sparse polygon witness to GP-ALL at the same corner budget.

atomic_claims.text: A rational sparse witness plus margin-two separator certificates supplies positive quadratic guards preserving all geometric clauses with bits fixed.
The displayed coefficient-weighted monomial variation bound gives a positive rational box radius preserving those guards and the sparse formula.
An M-by-M rational grid with M=C(n+m,2)+1 permits sequential line avoidance, restoring GP-ALL without changing the anchors, graph, bits or m.
The displayed four-corner K2 family has all twenty triple orientations nonzero for 0<h<=1/4 and preserves the c15 visibility/parity data.

assumptions: An exact rational satisfying sparse assignment, not an unverified solver label.
Supplied rational per-slot separator certificates with margin two, whose existence is covered by c12.
Bits and at most two fixed anchors are held constant; only free geometric coordinates are perturbed.
c01/c04/c07 polygon and parity semantics remain separate proof dependencies.
risks: No coefficient expansion, grid search, evaluator, solver or proof assistant was executed.
The radius and coordinate precision depend on the witness and certificates, not only on graph order or m.
Contact-only nonedges and arbitrary perturbations of Boolean bits are outside the theorem.
The c15 executable publication limitation remains; this non-executable proof does not retry that blocked code.
